fields.FIR_Description: The reported incident took place on 2025-08-18 (morning, 11:20): A person promoting a trading group collected Rs. 50,000 from the complainant with an assurance of high returns. Dinesh Raj approached Karur East PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000061. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100001. A person named Nithin Murugan, associated with the number 9000000374, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident. Items referenced in the complaint: a call detail reference, transaction records and digital documents. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00143, as the mobile number 9000000374 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Call detail reference; Transaction record; Digital document
fields.Modus_Operandi: Victim allegedly persuaded to deposit funds with a promise of high returns.
fields.Keywords: investment fraud, high returns, shopping complex, suspect, receiving account, mobile number, transaction record, morning
